title: Optional: Semantic Kernel VectorStore migration to CommunityToolkit.VectorData

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI&TCR video on the CommunityToolkit.VectorData release of 1.0.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看這段 AI 與 C# 影片，介紹 CommunityToolkit.VectorData 1.0。

cues.en: You might think, what in the world is that?
cues.zh: 你可能會想，這到底是什麼？

cues.en: So in order to better understand this, we need to clear our confusion and see a little
cues.zh: 為了更容易理解，先釐清一些混淆，看看

cues.en: history about what the vector store story has been in the Microsoft space in CCR.
cues.zh: 微軟 C# 生態裡，向量儲存區的發展歷史。

cues.en: So the timeline of being able to use RAC, because vector stores is equal to RAC.
cues.zh: 也就是使用 RAG 的發展過程，因為向量儲存區是 RAG 的一環。

cues.en: In this video, I'm not going to go into what RAC is.
cues.zh: 這段影片不會深入解釋 RAG 是什麼，

cues.en: I have videos directed on that, and also how to use the min-leading framework.
cues.zh: 我已經有專門影片介紹它，以及相關框架的使用方式。

cues.en: But more, how do we actually put our data into a vector store so we can use it for RAC?
cues.zh: 這裡關心的是，如何把資料放進向量儲存區，供 RAG 使用。

cues.en: So back in the day, the only real story Microsoft had with AI was Semantic Kernel.
cues.zh: 以前微軟 AI 生態裡，主要的選擇只有 Semantic Kernel，

cues.en: And that was good, but it didn't really do any RAC, because there was no RAC story for Microsoft at that point.
cues.zh: 它不錯，但最初沒有完整的 RAG 方案，因為當時微軟還沒有這套架構。

cues.en: So as always, what happened when we were back in the Semantic Kernel, Semantic Kernel made their own system in order to do vector data.
cues.zh: 因此 Semantic Kernel 團隊，先自行建立處理向量資料的系統。

cues.en: It was a very crude system that we could put some data into various vector stores, SQL
cues.zh: 那是一個比較初步的系統，可以把資料寫進不同向量儲存區，例如 SQL

cues.en: Server, Azure AI Search, SQLite, and so on.
cues.zh: Server、Azure AI Search、SQLite 等等。

cues.en: And it was okay.
cues.zh: 大致能用，

cues.en: I tried it out back in the day, and while it worked, it was a bit funky to work with.
cues.zh: 我當時也試過，雖然可以運作，但使用上有點彆扭。

cues.en: So what happened was that the Semantic Kernel team saw that this was something we needed in more general terms.
cues.zh: 後來 Semantic Kernel 團隊發現，這應該是一項更通用的能力。

cues.en: And at the same time where Microsoft Extensions AI were pushed, there was also something called MEVD.
cues.zh: 因此在 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 推出的同時，也出現了所謂的 MEVD。

cues.en: They didn't go too much into big fanfare about it, but it was Microsoft Extensions Vector Data.
cues.zh: 它沒有受到太多宣傳，全名是 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData。

cues.en: And the difference between Microsoft Extensions AI and Microsoft Extensions Vector Data is
cues.zh: Microsoft.Extensions.AI 和 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData 的差別是，

cues.en: that the vector data was only an abstract implementation, meaning it didn't implement
cues.zh: VectorData 只提供抽象層，並沒有實際

cues.en: any, but it just gave the raw interfaces and abstract methods to do a good vector data story.
cues.zh: 實作任何儲存區，而是提供處理向量資料所需的基本介面與抽象方法。

cues.en: The spec came up from the Semantic Kernel team, and they were also the ones who made the first connectors.
cues.zh: 規格由 Semantic Kernel 團隊提出，最初的連接器也是他們開發。

cues.en: So inside the Semantic Kernel repo, Microsoft Semantic Kernel.connectors.SQLServer.AzureAISearch,
cues.zh: 因此在 Semantic Kernel 儲存庫裡，有 Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.SqlServer、AzureAISearch，

cues.en: and so on. We were happy.
cues.zh: 以及其他連接器。當時這樣已經很好了。

cues.en: We now had Semantic Kernel.
cues.zh: 我們有 Semantic Kernel，

cues.en: We had a more abstract thing that only Semantic Kernel used, but at least there was a standard
cues.zh: 也有一套當時只有 Semantic Kernel 使用的抽象層，但至少建立了標準，

cues.en: so it could live for the future, and we had the implementations.
cues.zh: 讓未來可以持續發展，並且有可用的實作。

cues.en: Later on, as you all know, in October 2025, we got Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 後來大家都知道，2025 年 10 月推出了 Microsoft Agent Framework。

cues.en: And when we got that and looked into the repo of Microsoft Agent Framework, we saw no rack story, no vector data story.
cues.zh: 但檢查它的儲存庫，卻沒有看到 RAG 或向量資料的完整方案。

cues.en: And it made sense because they had made this Microsoft Extensions Vector Data abstract class, but we ended up not having anything new.
cues.zh: 這其實合理，因為抽象層已經在 Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData，不過沒有新增另一套實作。

cues.en: So we ended up sitting and migrating all our code to Microsoft Agent Framework, except
cues.zh: 所以我們把程式碼遷移到 Microsoft Agent Framework，

cues.en: our rack, because it was still in Semantic Kernel.
cues.zh: 卻唯獨 RAG 部分，仍留在 Semantic Kernel。

cues.en: Well, it wasn't really there. It was there.
cues.zh: 嚴格來說，也不是依賴整個 Semantic Kernel，只是程式放在那裡。

cues.en: The code was there.
cues.zh: 相關程式碼都在那裡，

cues.en: The implementation of the SQL Server, the SQLite, the Azure AI, and so on was there.
cues.zh: SQL Server、SQLite、Azure AI Search 等實作，也都在那裡，

cues.en: And they were in a namespace, Microsoft Semantic Kernel.
cues.zh: 而且使用 Microsoft.SemanticKernel 的命名空間。

cues.en: But beyond that, it didn't really fit that repo.
cues.zh: 但除此之外，其實已經不太適合放在那個儲存庫。

cues.en: And that was just confusing because we wanted to migrate to Agent Framework, but it was not everything we could migrate, at least in namespace.
cues.zh: 這造成混淆：想遷移到 Agent Framework，卻至少在命名空間上，無法全部搬過去。

cues.en: There was no real drawbacks to it, other than it was a strange name.
cues.zh: 除了名稱奇怪之外，實際上沒有什麼功能上的缺點。

cues.en: And this is what this video is about because it has finally been resolved now, in that
cues.zh: 這也正是這段影片的主題，因為現在終於解決了，

cues.en: the code that was in the Semantic Kernel repo have now been migrated over to the Community Toolkit Vector Data.
cues.zh: 原本放在 Semantic Kernel 儲存庫的程式碼，已經移到 CommunityToolkit.VectorData。

cues.en: And doing so is a fairly simple process, and I will show you that there's actually not much to it in order to switch to this.
cues.zh: 切換過程非常簡單，我會示範，實際上不需要改多少東西。

cues.en: It's now also being deprecated as a NuGet package, or the various NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 原本那些 NuGet 套件，現在也已經標記為棄用。

cues.en: So now we have this new one, and Community Toolkit, if you don't know, is a repo up in...
cues.zh: 所以有了新的套件。若你不熟悉 Community Toolkit，它是 GitHub 上的一個，

cues.en: an owner up in GitHub that Microsoft own and have all the less official, but still Microsoft-backed systems.
cues.zh: 由微軟管理的組織，放置比較偏社群、但仍有微軟支持的專案。

cues.en: So, for example, for vector data here.
cues.zh: 這裡的 VectorData 就是例子，

cues.en: So the official implementation abstract, this is how you implement it.
cues.zh: 官方的抽象介面負責定義實作方式，

cues.en: It's here, while we have the data.
cues.zh: 放在原本的位置，實際連接器則在這裡。

cues.en: I'm a bit surprised that it went up in Community Toolkit and not inside the Microsoft extensions, but they chose that.
cues.zh: 我有點意外它移到 Community Toolkit，而不是直接放進 Microsoft.Extensions，不過團隊就是這樣決定。

cues.en: Not really much of a problem for us.
cues.zh: 對我們來說，其實沒有什麼問題。

cues.en: Let's see what this means and how to migrate to it, now that we know.
cues.zh: 知道背景後，來看看這意味著什麼，以及怎麼遷移。

cues.en: So we have, for a long time, have Microsoft Extensions Vector Data abstractions.
cues.zh: Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.Abstractions 已經存在很久，

cues.en: You can see it's all the way back from 2024, and it has been moved up, and it lives in
cues.zh: 可以看到最早可追溯到 2024 年，後來持續更新，目前放在

cues.en: the Microsoft Extensions repo, as we can see in here.
cues.zh: Microsoft.Extensions 的儲存庫裡。

cues.en: But now we have these new packages, Community Toolkit.VectorData.something, and these are
cues.zh: 現在又有這些新的 CommunityToolkit.VectorData 開頭的套件，分別對應

cues.en: the different vector datas that we have, SQL Server, Cosmos, Azure, AI Search, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 不同向量儲存區，例如 SQL Server、Cosmos、Azure AI Search 等等。

cues.en: We have nine of them.
cues.zh: 總共有九個，

cues.en: We also have nine of them in Semantic Kernel.
cues.zh: Semantic Kernel 原本也有九個。

cues.en: And if we look at them, of course, they have a dependency on the vector data abstractions.
cues.zh: 檢查相依性，當然都依賴 VectorData.Abstractions。

cues.en: Of course, they work exactly the same.
cues.zh: 操作方式也完全相同。

cues.en: So how do we go about moving to these?
cues.zh: 那要怎麼移轉到新套件？

cues.en: So I made a small little program here, CommunityToolkit.VectorData, but I'm still using Semantic Kernel here.
cues.zh: 我建立了一個小程式，名稱是 CommunityToolkit.VectorData，但目前還在使用 Semantic Kernel。

cues.en: In this case, the SQL Vector, and just for reference, the code is just taking some data,
cues.zh: 這裡使用 SQLite 向量儲存區。先說明一下，程式只是取得一些資料，

cues.en: in this case, a null space, set up data.
cues.zh: 這裡是知識庫的範例資料，

cues.en: It's making the embedding generator, so we can hook that up to the VectorStore.
cues.zh: 建立嵌入產生器，再把它接到 VectorStore。

cues.en: We make the VectorStore, in this case of type SQL VectorStore, with our connection string and the embedding generator.
cues.zh: 用連線字串和嵌入產生器，建立 SqliteVectorStore。

cues.en: So we have the abstract part, and if we look at this, this is the Microsoft Extension vector
cues.zh: 所以這邊是抽象型別，查看就知道它來自 Microsoft.Extensions.Vector

cues.en: data, while this one is, if we jump into it, you'll see that it's a Microsoft Semantic
cues.zh: Data；另一邊如果跳進去，則會看到這是 Microsoft.Semantic

cues.en: Kernel implementation of that VectorStore.
cues.zh: Kernel 提供的 VectorStore 實作。

cues.en: Of course, this is just SQLite, but if you want to have an Azure AI search, you do something
cues.zh: 目前使用 SQLite，但如果改用 Azure AI Search，也只需要

cues.en: very similar, but you just new up an Azure AI VectorStore with a search index and some credentials, but still get back a VectorStore.
cues.zh: 類似的做法，建立 Azure AI VectorStore，傳入搜尋索引與認證資訊，最後仍然得到 VectorStore。

cues.en: If you want a SQL server, you do the same with a connection string, and if you want a Cosmos DB, you do more or less the same as well.
cues.zh: SQL Server 一樣傳連線字串，Cosmos DB 也大致相同。

cues.en: So the VectorStore is the abstract part, and these are the implementations, but again,
cues.zh: 所以 VectorStore 是抽象層，其他是各自的實作。只是再次看到，

cues.en: we can see we are in a Microsoft Semantic Kernel Connectors data, and when we just delete
cues.zh: 目前這裡用的仍是 Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors。接著刪除、

cues.en: and create again, just so it shouldn't really delete every single time, of course, but just
cues.zh: 重建集合；當然正式使用時不應每次刪除，這裡只是為了示範。然後

cues.en: go in and upsert our data into a vector record here, again, I have dedicated videos about
cues.zh: 把資料 Upsert 成向量記錄。我有專門影片介紹，

cues.en: exactly what every single little part of this is, because we have covered it multiple times
cues.zh: 每個部分實際做什麼，因為前面已經介紹過很多次。

cues.en: before, but the big main part here is this package is now deprecated, so we need to get
cues.zh: 這裡最主要的是，這個套件現在已經棄用，所以得

cues.en: rid of that and switch over to the new system, and you might think, oh no, we need to do a migration.
cues.zh: 移除並換成新套件。你可能會想：「糟糕，又得做遷移了。」

cues.en: Well, that migration is pretty easy, because what we can do is just go to here and say,
cues.zh: 但這次遷移真的很簡單，只要到這裡，

cues.en: I don't want this anymore, we delete it, we go to Community Toolkits, spell that VectorData,
cues.zh: 把不再需要的舊套件刪除，再搜尋 CommunityToolkit.VectorData，

cues.en: and there we have the new packages, they are in version 1.0.
cues.zh: 就能找到這些新套件，目前是 1.0 版。

cues.en: The previous was actually in preview, but now they have moved up, you can see that all
cues.zh: 舊版原本還在預覽階段，但現在多數已經正式發布，可以看到，

cues.en: of them, but the vector SQLite is in preview, it's not in preview, but we can take this
cues.zh: 其中 SQLite 向量套件仍標示預覽。總之選擇這個，

cues.en: one, install it, so instead of the Microsoft Symmetric Kernel Connectors SQLiteVec, we
cues.zh: 安裝之後，原本的 Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.SqliteVec，

cues.en: now have CommunityToolkitVectorData.SQLiteVec, so that's the new namespace here, and if we
cues.zh: 就換成 CommunityToolkit.VectorData.SqliteVec。這就是新的命名空間。再看看

cues.en: look at our code, of course, it complains that Symmetric Kernel doesn't exist here,
cues.zh: 程式碼，當然會提示找不到 Semantic Kernel，

cues.en: but we can just go in and take this using and turn it into CommunityToolkit.VectorData.SQLVector,
cues.zh: 但只要把這個 using 換成 CommunityToolkit.VectorData.SqliteVec，

cues.en: and the rest is up and running completely as before, so it is only a move of the data,
cues.zh: 其餘程式就和平常一樣完整運作。所以只是把程式碼，

cues.en: nothing more, to a different namespace.
cues.zh: 搬到不同的命名空間而已。

cues.en: Everything else is exactly the same, down to search, to collection, to everything, just a move of the data to a different namespace.
cues.zh: 從 Search、Collection 到其他全部操作都完全相同，只有命名空間改變。

cues.en: So the migration is very, very easy, find your usings, and switch to the NuGet package
cues.zh: 因此遷移非常容易，找出 using，切換 NuGet 套件，

cues.en: and then you are back again.
cues.zh: 就可以繼續使用。

cues.en: So that's actually everything for this video, see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 這段影片就到這裡，下次見。
